MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The alligator clips and electronic cleaner fit the electrical repair work suggested by my wire connectors: they help with temporary connections and maintenance.",
    "The stainless washer assortment feels useful in the same way as my hose clamp assortment, giving me several sizes for practical repairs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The cutting wheels, step drill bit, and plug tap depend on particular tools or tasks that my purchases do not establish. The tap's exact thread size makes it especially hard to justify.",
    "The locking nuts require matching bolt sizes, while the foam sealant requires a sealing project and applicator gun. Neither follows directly from buying clamps or adhesive.",
    "The COVID test has no clear connection to the repair supplies I am considering or any health need I have expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying repair supplies seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest almost any metalworking accessory, even when it serves a different job.",
    "My adhesive purchases seem to have been stretched into an interest in window and door insulation, although those products solve different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My clamp and connector assortments make broadly useful repair supplies plausible choices, but they do not establish a need for a particular thread size or cutting wheel diameter.",
    "I need a clear practical use before choosing another supply. Electrical maintenance has some support in my history; a current cutting, drilling, or insulation project does not."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly understood my practical repair interests but assumed specific projects and tool compatibility that my purchases do not establish."
}
